mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, change_kind, impacted_user_count, version_bumped_count, profile_refreshed_count, profile_evicted_count, processed_at FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_authorization_invalidation_event (id, event_id, change_kind, impacted_user_count, version_bumped_count, profile_refreshed_count, profile_evicted_count, processed_at, created_at, updated_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{changeKind}, #{impactedUserCount}, #{versionBumpedCount}, #{profileRefreshedCount}, #{profileEvictedCount}, #{processedAt}, #{processedAt}, #{processedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_authorization_invalidation_event SET impacted_user_count = #{impactedUserCount}, version_bumped_count = #{versionBumpedCount}, profile_refreshed_count = #{profileRefreshedCount}, profile_evicted_count = #{profileEvictedCount}, processed_at = #{processedAt}, updated_at = #{processedAt} WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND impacted_user_count = -1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND impacted_user_count = -1
mapper.select: SELECT aie.id, aie.event_id, aie.change_kind, aie.impacted_user_count, aie.version_bumped_count, aie.profile_refreshed_count, aie.profile_evicted_count, aie.processed_at, aie.created_at, aie.updated_at, aie.created_by, aie.updated_by, aie.remark FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event aie WHERE aie.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(IF(aie.impacted_user_count = -1, 1, 0)) AS processing_count, SUM(IF(aie.impacted_user_count != -1, 1, 0)) AS completed_count FROM auth_authorization_invalidation_event aie
